title: Riot X Nic Salts Apple Sour Strawberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Riot X Nic Salts Apple Sour Strawberry delivers a highly refreshing fruit profile that perfectly balances sweet and tart notes. The inhale provides a crisp burst of Green Apple paired with the juicy sweetness of classic Strawberry. This vibrant fruit combination is then finished with a sharp sour kick and a clean, refreshing hint of Ice on the exhale, creating a dynamic and intensely satisfying vape. This e-liquid features Riot's Hybrid Nicotine formula, which blends Nic Salt and freebase for quick satisfaction, a smooth throat feel, and modest vapour production. With its 50VG/50PG profile, this vape juice is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping and performs well with pod kits, refillable starter kits, and compact vape pens. Made in the UK, the Riot X Nic Salts range focuses on full-impact fruit blends designed for everyday use in low-powered refillable devices.
